workflows.title: Inbound lead qualifier
workflows.summary: A form submission becomes an enriched, scored lead in the CRM, and the right rep gets a Slack message with the reason, all within 60 seconds.

workflows.title: Account research brief
workflows.summary: Paste a domain (or trigger from a new CRM company) and get a one-page brief: what they do, size, stack, recent news, hiring signals and three angles to open with.

workflows.title: Outbound first-line writer
workflows.summary: Upload or sync a lead list and get, per lead, a personal opening line plus the specific reason it is relevant, written to the sheet or sequencer.

workflows.title: Pre-call brief
workflows.summary: One hour before any external meeting, the rep gets a brief in Slack or email: who is attending, their roles, account history from the CRM, open deal status, last conversation summary and three suggested questions.

workflows.title: Call to CRM
workflows.summary: When a call recording is ready, the CRM gets a summary, next steps, updated deal fields and a drafted follow-up email waiting for the rep's approval.

workflows.title: Stale deal nudger
workflows.summary: Every weekday morning, each rep gets a short list of their deals that have gone quiet, with a specific suggested next action for each based on the deal's history.

workflows.title: CRM hygiene
workflows.summary: Every night the CRM is cleaned: duplicate contacts and companies merged or flagged, fields normalised (country, phone, title, industry), and records missing key data listed for owners.

workflows.title: Champion job-change tracker
workflows.summary: Watches your past champions and customers, and when one moves to a new company, creates a lead at the new company with context and alerts the account owner.

workflows.title: Proposal generator
workflows.summary: From a deal's fields and call notes, generates a branded proposal (scope, pricing table, timeline, terms), routes it for internal approval, then sends it for e-signature and updates the deal when signed.

workflows.title: Reply classifier
workflows.summary: Every reply to outbound email is classified (interested, not now, referral, unsubscribe, out of office, wrong person, bounce) and handled: interested replies go to the rep instantly, unsubscribes are honoured everywhere, out-of-office dates pause the sequence until the person returns.

workflows.title: Website visitor to lead
workflows.summary: Turns identified company visits to high-intent pages into account alerts and leads with the right contact suggested, so reps call the companies already reading the pricing page.

workflows.title: Weekly pipeline digest
workflows.summary: Every Monday, the team gets a digest: pipeline created, moved, won and lost, coverage against target, slipping deals, and the three things worth discussing in the pipeline meeting.

workflows.title: Ticket triage
workflows.summary: Every new ticket gets category, priority, language, sentiment and intent set within seconds, is routed to the right team or person, and urgent ones page the on-call lead.

workflows.title: Grounded reply drafts with approval
workflows.summary: For each triaged ticket in an eligible category, drafts a reply grounded only in the knowledge base and policies, with citations and a confidence score, and puts it in front of an agent to approve, edit or reject.

workflows.title: Refund and return handler
workflows.summary: Refund and return requests are checked against policy and order data, a recommended decision is prepared with the math, and an approver executes it in one click.

workflows.title: Support QA scorer
workflows.summary: Each week, samples closed tickets per agent and scores them against your QA rubric (accuracy, tone, resolution, policy), with coaching notes, so leads review 5 flagged tickets instead of 50 random ones.

workflows.title: Churn signal detector
workflows.summary: Combines negative ticket sentiment, usage drops, failed payments and cancellation language into one risk score per account and alerts the owner with the evidence and a suggested save play.

workflows.title: Knowledge base gap finder
workflows.summary: Finds questions customers keep asking that the knowledge base does not answer, clusters them, and drafts new articles for review.

workflows.title: Bug report to issue
workflows.summary: Support tickets that report bugs become clean engineering issues in Linear or Jira, deduplicated against open issues, with steps to reproduce, environment and affected customers, and the ticket is linked so support hears when it ships.

workflows.title: CSAT and NPS theme analysis
workflows.summary: Weekly, groups CSAT and NPS comments into themes with counts, trends and example quotes, so product and support see what is driving scores.

workflows.title: Onboarding check-ins from product events
workflows.summary: New accounts get timely, specific check-ins based on what they have and have not done in the product (not a fixed drip), and stuck accounts are flagged to their CSM.

workflows.title: SLA breach early warning
workflows.summary: Warns the team before tickets breach SLA: at 75% of the time budget the assignee is pinged, at 90% the lead, with a single view of everything at risk.

workflows.title: Multilingual reply layer
workflows.summary: Agents read every ticket in their language and reply in their language; the customer receives a natural reply in theirs, with a glossary that keeps product terms consistent.

workflows.title: Weekly support operations report
workflows.summary: Every Monday: volume, backlog, first response and resolution times, SLA attainment, CSAT, top categories and what changed, per team.

workflows.title: Content repurposer
workflows.summary: One article or video becomes an X thread, a LinkedIn post, a newsletter blurb and carousel copy, in the brand's voice, queued for approval and then scheduled.

workflows.title: Video or podcast to blog post and show notes
workflows.summary: A new video or podcast episode becomes a publish-ready blog draft, show notes with timestamps and chapter markers, and a pull-quote list, saved as a draft in the CMS.

workflows.title: SEO brief from keyword and live results
workflows.summary: Type a keyword and get a writer-ready brief built from the current top results: search intent, outline, questions to answer, entities to cover, internal links and a target length.

workflows.title: Content refresh finder
workflows.summary: Monthly, finds pages losing clicks or rankings in Search Console and turns each into a refresh brief explaining what dropped and what to update.

workflows.title: Social publishing queue with approval
workflows.summary: A single queue (sheet, Notion or Airtable) where anyone can add posts; each post goes through approval and then publishes at its slot, with the live link written back.

workflows.title: Competitor monitor
workflows.summary: Weekly, checks competitors' pricing pages, changelogs and key pages, diffs them against last week, and sends a short report of what actually changed and why it matters.

workflows.title: Brand mention listener
workflows.summary: Finds mentions of the brand and products across Reddit, Hacker News, X and news, filters noise, and posts the ones worth answering to Slack with a suggested reply.

workflows.title: Newsletter curator
workflows.summary: Collects the week's saved links and feed items, ranks them for the audience, writes short blurbs and assembles a draft issue in the email platform.

workflows.title: Weekly ad performance report
workflows.summary: Every Monday, pulls spend and results from Google Ads, Meta and LinkedIn Ads, normalises them, flags anomalies and sends a one-screen report with what to change.

workflows.title: Review and testimonial harvester
workflows.summary: Collects reviews from G2, Capterra, Trustpilot and app stores, plus praise in support tickets and NPS comments, and turns the best ones into an approved testimonial bank with permission tracking.

workflows.title: Webinar and event follow-up sequence
workflows.summary: After a webinar or event, attendees and no-shows get different follow-ups within the hour (recording, slides, a relevant next step), and engaged attendees are scored and routed to sales.

workflows.title: Lead magnet delivery and nurture
workflows.summary: When someone downloads a guide, they get it instantly, are added to the right list with consent recorded, and receive a 4-email nurture tied to the guide's topic, stopping as soon as they book a call or reply.

workflows.title: Incident triage
workflows.summary: When an alert fires, the incident channel gets a summary within two minutes: what is broken, since when, the deploys and config changes just before it, the top errors, the owning team and the runbook.

workflows.title: PR review trigger
workflows.summary: On every pull request, runs the PR reviewer agent and posts a summary comment plus inline suggestions, skipping drafts, bots and trivial changes, and respecting a per-repo config file.

workflows.title: Release notes from merged PRs
workflows.summary: On every release tag, gathers merged PRs since the last tag and writes grouped, customer-readable release notes, published to GitHub Releases and the changelog, with internal notes kept separate.

workflows.title: Dependency and CVE watcher
workflows.summary: Scans repos for vulnerable dependencies daily, filters to what is actually reachable and exploitable in your context, and files prioritised issues with the fix version, deduplicated across repos.

workflows.title: Issue groomer
workflows.summary: New issues get labels, a type, a likely area owner, duplicate detection and a polite request for missing information, so the backlog stays clean without a weekly grooming meeting.

workflows.title: Daily standup digest
workflows.summary: Each morning, every team gets a digest of what moved yesterday per person (merged PRs, reviewed PRs, issues closed and started) and what is blocked, so standup is about blockers.

workflows.title: Error spike summary with owner routing
workflows.summary: When an error spikes or a new error appears after a deploy, the owning team gets a summary with the stack frame, the suspect commit and affected users, before customers report it.

workflows.title: Docs drift checker
workflows.summary: When an API changes, finds the docs pages that describe the changed endpoints or parameters and opens a docs PR with proposed updates.

workflows.title: Flaky test tracker
workflows.summary: Finds tests that pass and fail on the same commit, tracks their flake rate, files one issue per flaky test with failure samples, and posts a weekly top-10.

workflows.title: Daily cloud cost digest
workflows.summary: Daily cost by service and team with anomaly alerts when spend jumps, plus the likely cause (new resource, traffic, misconfiguration).

workflows.title: New hire repo tour generator
workflows.summary: For a new engineer, generates a guided tour of a repo: architecture overview, key directories, how to run it, where to start, and five good first issues, as a Markdown doc in the repo wiki or Notion.

workflows.title: Changelog to launch posts
workflows.summary: Turns each release's highlights into launch drafts (X, LinkedIn, changelog email, in-app announcement) and hands them to the marketing approval queue.

workflows.title: Invoice and receipt capture
workflows.summary: Invoices and receipts arriving by email or upload are extracted, checked (math, duplicates, vendor, PO, tax) and posted to the accounting tool as drafts, or to a sheet, with anything doubtful sent for review.

workflows.title: Weekly KPI report
workflows.summary: Every Monday, pulls revenue from billing, product usage from analytics and pipeline from the CRM, computes the company's core KPIs with week-over-week changes, and sends one report leadership actually reads.

workflows.title: Contract intake and renewal reminders
workflows.summary: Signed contracts dropped in a folder or attached to email get their key terms extracted (parties, dates, value, auto-renewal, notice period, termination, price escalators) into a register, with renewal reminders scheduled before the notice deadline.

workflows.title: Spend anomaly detection
workflows.summary: Daily, scans card and expense exports for duplicates, unusual amounts, new merchants, weekend spend and policy breaches, and sends finance a short list with reasons.

workflows.title: Meeting notes to action items
workflows.summary: After a meeting, action items from the notes or transcript become tasks in the team's tool with owners and due dates, and the summary goes to the meeting channel.

workflows.title: Vendor onboarding
workflows.summary: New vendors get a form that collects tax forms, bank details, insurance and security documents; the workflow checks completeness, routes approvals and creates the vendor in the accounting tool.

workflows.title: Failed payment recovery sequence
workflows.summary: When a subscription payment fails, customers get a well-timed, friendly sequence with a card update link, high-value accounts get a personal touch from their owner, and recovered revenue is tracked.

workflows.title: Month-end close checklist automation
workflows.summary: Creates the month-end close checklist with owners and due dates, runs the automatable checks (bank reconciliation status, unposted bills, uncategorised transactions, accrual reminders) and tracks completion.

workflows.title: Internal Q&A over company docs in Slack
workflows.summary: Employees ask questions in Slack and get answers grounded in company docs with links, respecting document permissions, and 'I don't know' when the docs don't say.

workflows.title: Employee onboarding and offboarding access checklist
workflows.summary: When someone joins or leaves, creates the access checklist for every tool they need or had, provisions what the APIs allow, assigns the rest to owners, and confirms everything is done, with an audit trail.

workflows.title: Purchase request approvals
workflows.summary: Purchase requests go through the right approvers by amount and category, with budget checks, and approved requests create the PO or the vendor task.

workflows.title: Investor update draft
workflows.summary: On the first of the month, drafts the investor update from the month's metrics, highlights, lowlights and asks, for the founder to edit and send.

agents.title: Account research
agents.summary: Given a company domain (and optionally a person and a goal for the meeting), researches the account across the web and the buyer's CRM and returns a cited brief with angles to open with.

agents.title: Inbound qualifier
agents.summary: Qualifies an inbound lead end to end: validates, enriches, scores against the ICP with explainable reasons, assigns an owner and drafts the first touch, then asks for approval before writing to the CRM or messaging anyone.

agents.title: Outbound personaliser
agents.summary: For each lead in a list, finds one genuine, verifiable reason to reach out and writes a first line and a short email that uses it, refusing to fake familiarity.

agents.title: Meeting prep and follow-up
agents.summary: Before a meeting, writes the brief; after it, turns the transcript into a summary, CRM updates and a follow-up email draft, all waiting for the rep's approval.

agents.title: CRM hygiene
agents.summary: Audits a CRM slice for duplicates, bad formats and missing data, proposes a patch plan with reasons, and applies approved changes safely in batches.

agents.title: Proposal drafter
agents.summary: Drafts a proposal for a deal: narrative from call notes, pricing computed by tools (never by the model), timeline and terms from templates, then routes for approval and e-signature.

agents.title: RFP responder
agents.summary: Answers security questionnaires and RFPs from an approved answer library and product docs, with citations, confidence per answer and a list of questions that need an expert.

agents.title: Objection coach
agents.summary: Gives reps grounded responses to objections (price, timing, competitor, security) using the buyer's battlecards, win stories and call history, in a quick chat or after a call.

agents.title: Territory planner
agents.summary: Proposes balanced territories and account assignments from accounts, rep capacity and constraints, explaining trade-offs, as a plan the sales leader approves.

agents.title: Win-loss analyst
agents.summary: Analyses closed deals (notes, call transcripts, loss reasons) and produces win-loss themes with evidence and recommendations each quarter.

agents.title: Content repurposer
agents.summary: Turns one source (article, video, podcast) into channel-ready drafts in the brand's voice, grounded in the source, and queues them for approval.

agents.title: SEO brief and refresh
agents.summary: Builds new-content briefs from live search results and diagnoses decaying pages with specific refresh instructions.

agents.title: Competitor watcher
agents.summary: Tracks competitor pricing, changelogs and positioning and answers 'what changed and what should we do about it' with evidence.

agents.title: Ad performance analyst
agents.summary: Answers questions about ad performance across platforms and writes weekly findings with anomalies and three concrete actions, never inventing numbers.

agents.title: Newsletter editor
agents.summary: Curates and writes the weekly newsletter from collected links in the publication's voice, with verified links, and creates a draft in the ESP.

agents.title: Brand voice editor
agents.summary: Edits any draft to match the brand voice guide, explains each change, and scores drafts against the voice rubric; used by other marketing items as a shared checker.

agents.title: Trend scout
agents.summary: Finds rising topics in the buyer's niche from search trends, communities and news, and proposes content angles with evidence of momentum.

agents.title: Landing page critic
agents.summary: Reviews a landing page against conversion and clarity heuristics, with screenshots at desktop and mobile, and returns prioritised fixes tied to elements.

agents.title: Community manager
agents.summary: Monitors community channels (Discord, Slack community, forum), answers common questions from docs with citations, tags and routes the rest, and drafts weekly community digests.

agents.title: Launch planner
agents.summary: Builds a launch plan for a release: audience, channels, assets checklist, timeline and owners, from the release notes and past launches, as tasks in the team's tool.

agents.title: Ticket triage
agents.summary: Triages a ticket fully: cleans it, detects language, looks up the customer, classifies category, intent, sentiment and priority with reasons, and routes it, applying writes after approval or by policy.

agents.title: Grounded answer agent with citations
agents.summary: Answers customer questions only from the knowledge base and policies, with sentence-level citations, and says clearly when the answer is not in the sources.

agents.title: Refund decision agent with approval
agents.summary: Evaluates a refund or return request against policy and order data, computes the eligible amount with a tool, drafts the customer reply, and executes only after a human approves.

agents.title: Support QA reviewer
agents.summary: Scores closed conversations against the team's QA rubric with evidence quotes and coaching notes, calibrated to human graders.

agents.title: Churn risk watcher
agents.summary: Watches support, usage and billing signals, explains which accounts are at risk and why, and proposes a save play for the owner.

agents.title: Docs gap finder
agents.summary: Finds what customers ask that the docs do not answer, clusters it, and drafts the missing articles from the best agent replies.

agents.title: Voice of customer analyst
agents.summary: Answers 'what are customers telling us' across tickets, surveys, reviews and calls, with themes, trends and quotes, for any segment and period.

agents.title: Macro writer
agents.summary: Finds repetitive replies in solved tickets and proposes reusable macros with variables, linked to the KB, for the team to approve.

agents.title: Escalation summariser
agents.summary: When a ticket escalates to engineering or management, writes a crisp summary: customer, impact, timeline, what was tried, open questions and the ask.

agents.title: Onboarding coach
agents.summary: Guides new customers through setup based on what they have done, answering questions in-app or by email with links to the exact next step.

agents.title: PR reviewer
agents.summary: Reviews a pull request like a careful senior engineer: understands the intent, reads the changed code with surrounding context, finds real bugs, security issues and missing tests, and posts precise inline comments with suggested fixes, without nitpicking style a linter already covers.

agents.title: Incident triage
agents.summary: Investigates an alert: gathers recent changes, errors, metrics and logs for the affected service, ranks hypotheses with evidence, and keeps the incident channel updated, without claiming a root cause it cannot prove.

agents.title: Release notes writer
agents.summary: Writes customer-facing and internal release notes from merged PRs and issues, grouped and linked, in the product's voice.

agents.title: Dependency and CVE fixer
agents.summary: Triages vulnerability findings for reachability and real risk, then opens minimal upgrade PRs with changelog notes and test results, escalating breaking upgrades to humans.

agents.title: Test writer
agents.summary: Adds meaningful tests for changed or uncovered code: reads the code and its callers, writes tests in the repo's framework and style, runs them in a sandbox, and keeps only tests that pass and increase coverage.

agents.title: Issue groomer
agents.summary: Keeps the backlog clean: labels, finds duplicates, asks for missing information once, suggests owners from CODEOWNERS, and closes stale issues by policy.

agents.title: Migration assistant
agents.summary: Plans and executes mechanical code migrations (framework upgrades, API renames) in small verified steps with codemods first and model edits second, opening PRs per step.

agents.title: Docs writer
agents.summary: Writes and updates developer docs from code and API changes (OpenAPI, exported types), following the docs site's structure and voice, with runnable examples.

agents.title: On-call handoff
agents.summary: At shift change, writes the handoff: open incidents and their state, noisy alerts, ongoing deploys and risky changes, and what to watch next.

agents.title: Cloud cost optimiser
agents.summary: Finds savings in cloud spend (idle resources, oversized instances, unattached volumes, old snapshots, missing commitments) with estimated monthly savings and safe change plans.

agents.title: Invoice and receipt extractor
agents.summary: Extracts invoices and receipts into structured data with per-field confidence, runs math, duplicate, vendor and PO checks, and posts approved documents to the ledger.

agents.title: KPI reporter
agents.summary: Answers metric questions ('why did NRR drop?') and writes the weekly KPI narrative from computed metrics, drilling into drivers with tools rather than guessing.

agents.title: Contract analyst
agents.summary: Reads contracts, extracts key terms with clause quotes and page numbers, flags risky or non-standard clauses against the buyer's playbook, and keeps the renewal register current.

agents.title: Spend anomaly
agents.summary: Reviews card and expense transactions for anomalies and policy breaches, explains each with evidence, and asks cardholders for context through approved messages.

agents.title: Meeting to tasks
agents.summary: Turns meeting notes or transcripts into decisions and tasks with owners and due dates, creating them in the team's tool with evidence links.

agents.title: Internal knowledge
agents.summary: Answers employee questions from company docs with citations, respecting each employee's document permissions, and refuses when the docs do not say.

agents.title: Month-end close assistant
agents.summary: Runs the close checklist checks, explains reconciliation gaps, drafts accrual entries for review, and reports close status daily.

agents.title: Vendor risk reviewer
agents.summary: Reviews a new vendor's security and compliance documents (SOC 2 report, DPA, insurance, questionnaire) and returns a risk summary with gaps and follow-up questions.

agents.title: Investor update writer
agents.summary: Drafts the monthly investor update in the founder's voice from metrics, highlights, lowlights and asks, with every number traced to the KPI snapshot.

agents.title: Policy Q&A
agents.summary: Answers employee questions about company policies (expenses, leave, travel, security) with exact policy citations and the effective date, escalating ambiguous cases to the policy owner.

components.title: Chat thread
components.summary: The message list for an AI conversation: user and assistant turns, streaming assistant messages, tool-call cards and citations inline, message actions (copy, retry, edit, branch), and sticky scroll that follows the stream without fighting the reader.

components.title: Streaming message
components.summary: Renders model output as it streams: Markdown parsed incrementally without flicker, a caret at the insertion point, partial code blocks that stay highlighted, and stable layout so the page does not jump.

components.title: Prompt input with slash commands
components.summary: The composer for AI apps: auto-growing textarea, slash commands with a filterable menu, @-mentions for context items, attachments, a model or tool selector slot, and a submit button that becomes Stop while generating.

components.title: Tool-call card
components.summary: Shows an agent's tool call: name, arguments, status (pending, running, needs approval, done, failed), duration and a collapsible result, with an approval affordance when the call needs a human.

components.title: Citation chip
components.summary: Inline numbered citation that previews its source on hover or focus (title, domain, snippet, favicon) and links out; plus a source list that groups citations under an answer.

components.title: Reasoning disclosure
components.summary: Shows a model's reasoning or plan as a collapsed 'Thought for 12 s' line that expands to the streamed reasoning text, auto-collapsing when the answer starts.

components.title: Model picker
components.summary: Choose a model by provider with capability badges (vision, tools, reasoning), context window, price per million tokens and speed tier, plus search and favorites.

components.title: File drop with parsing state
components.summary: Drop zone and file list for AI ingestion that shows each file's lifecycle: uploading, parsing (pages, OCR), chunking, indexed or failed, with progress and per-file errors.

components.title: Voice input orb
components.summary: A microphone control that visualises live input level as an orb, shows listening, processing and speaking states, and hands audio to the parent (it does not do speech recognition itself).

components.title: Token and cost meter
components.summary: Shows context window usage and spend for a conversation or run: a segmented bar (system, history, tools, output), totals, cost in currency and a warning as the limit nears.

components.title: Approval card
components.summary: The human-in-the-loop decision unit: what the agent wants to do, why, the exact payload (with a diff when it changes something), risk and confidence, and Approve, Edit, Reject with a reason.

components.title: Run timeline
components.summary: A vertical timeline of an agent or workflow run: each step with type (model call, tool call, approval wait, branch, error), duration bar, tokens and cost, expandable inputs and outputs, and live updates while running.

components.title: Step status list
components.summary: A compact checklist of steps with status icons (pending, running, done, skipped, failed) for showing progress inside cards, toasts and chat.

components.title: Diff viewer
components.summary: Shows what an agent wants to change: text diffs (unified or split, word-level highlights), JSON or record field diffs, and code diffs with syntax highlighting, with per-hunk accept or reject when interactive.

components.title: Human handoff banner
components.summary: A banner in an AI conversation that marks when an agent hands off to a human (or a human takes over), showing who, why, expected wait and what the human can see.

components.title: Confidence badge
components.summary: Shows a model's confidence as a labelled level (High, Medium, Low) with the numeric value on hover and the reasons behind it, using thresholds the product sets.

components.title: Retry and undo toast
components.summary: Toasts for agent actions that can be undone within a window or retried after failure, with a visible countdown and an action button that stays reachable by keyboard.

components.title: Agent avatar with status
components.summary: An avatar for an agent with a live status ring (idle, thinking, acting, waiting for approval, error, offline) and a tooltip with the current activity.

components.title: Data grid
components.summary: A production table for business data: sorting (multi), filtering per column type, column pinning, resizing and hiding, row selection with bulk actions, inline editing with validation, grouping with subtotals, CSV export, server-side data mode and virtualization for 100k rows.

components.title: KPI stat with delta
components.summary: A metric tile: label, value, delta versus a comparison period with direction and semantics (up can be bad), optional sparkline and target progress.

components.title: Sparkline
components.summary: A tiny inline trend line or bar with an optional last-point marker and min and max dots, SVG only, no axes.

components.title: Line chart
components.summary: Time series line chart with multiple series, scrub tooltip, comparison period overlay (dashed), annotations for events (deploys, campaigns) and gap handling.

components.title: Area chart
components.summary: Stacked or overlapping area chart for composition over time (pipeline by stage, cost by model).

components.title: Bar chart
components.summary: Vertical or horizontal bars, grouped or stacked, with value labels and sorted options.

components.title: Donut chart
components.summary: Part-to-whole with a center total, a legend with values and percentages, and segment focus.

components.title: Funnel chart
components.summary: Stage-by-stage conversion with counts, step and overall conversion rates, and drop-off highlighting; horizontal bar funnel (not trapezoids) for readability.

components.title: Cohort heatmap
components.summary: Retention or revenue cohort table with a sequential color scale, values or percentages, row and column hover crosshair and a legend.

components.title: Activity timeline
components.summary: Chronological feed of human and system events on a record (emails, calls, notes, status changes, agent actions) grouped by day, with filters by type and expandable entries.

components.title: Command palette
components.summary: Cmd+K palette with grouped commands, recent items, async search across records, nested pages (drill into 'Assign to...'), shortcuts display and actions that run with feedback.

components.title: Combobox
components.summary: Searchable single select with async options, create-new, grouped options, rich option rendering and virtualization for long lists.

components.title: Date range picker
components.summary: Two-month calendar with presets (Today, Last 7 days, This quarter), comparison range option, typed input, timezone label and min and max constraints.

components.title: Multi-select tags
components.summary: Select many values as removable tags with search, create, max selections and overflow '+3' display.

components.title: Number field
components.summary: Locale-aware numeric input with steppers, min, max, step, currency and percent formatting while not focused, raw editing while focused, and scrub-to-change on the label.

components.title: Rich text editor
components.summary: Tiptap-based editor for replies, notes and prompts: Markdown shortcuts, slash menu, mentions, variables as atomic chips ({{customer.name}}), links, code, tables optional, Markdown and HTML in and out.

components.title: Cron schedule picker
components.summary: Build schedules without writing cron: presets (hourly, daily at, weekdays at, monthly on), a visual builder, advanced raw cron with validation, a human-readable summary and the next 5 run times in a chosen timezone.

components.title: Variable mapper
components.summary: Map fields from a source (webhook payload, CSV columns, previous step output) to target fields with type hints, auto-match by name, transforms (trim, lower, date format) and a live preview from sample data.

components.title: Node canvas viewer
components.summary: Read-only (optionally editable) canvas that renders an n8n, Make or internal workflow graph with auto-layout, zoom and pan, minimap, run-state overlay (which nodes ran, failed, were skipped) and a playback mode that steps through an execution.

components.title: Node card
components.summary: The node visual used on canvases and in lists: app icon, name, operation, status, small output count, error badge and ports.

components.title: Connector line
components.summary: Animated connector paths for graphs and diagrams: straight, step and curved or wavy, with data-flow animation, labels and states (idle, active, done, error).

components.title: Run log viewer
components.summary: A fast log viewer for workflow and agent runs: virtualized lines, level filters, search with highlights, JSON pretty-print on expand, follow mode for live logs and copy or download.

components.title: Trigger picker
components.summary: Choose how a workflow starts: webhook (with URL copy and auth method), schedule (uses cron picker), app event (searchable catalog of apps and events), manual, form; with a test-event step that waits for and shows a sample payload.

components.title: Credential slot
components.summary: Shows a required credential for an integration: app, scopes needed, connection status, connect or reconnect via OAuth or API key form, test connection, and which steps use it.

components.title: Sidebar
components.summary: App sidebar with sections, nested items, badges, collapsible icon rail mode, pinned items, keyboard navigation and a mobile sheet variant.

components.title: Top bar with workspace switcher
components.summary: App top bar with workspace and project switcher (search, recent, create), breadcrumbs, global search trigger, notifications and user menu.

components.title: Tabs
